fact.en: In a series circuit, electric current has only one path to follow, so all the parts share the same single loop.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, iisa lang ang dinadaanan ng electric current, kaya lahat ng bahagi ay nakasakay sa iisang loop.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, usa ra ang agianan sa electric current, busa ang tanang parte nag-ambit sa samang usa ka loop.

cards.illustration: A simple loop of wire connecting a battery to two small bulbs, with arrows showing the current moving in one direction around the single loop.

fact.en: A parallel circuit gives electric current several branches to flow through, so each appliance can have its own separate path.
fact.tl: Ang parallel circuit ay nagbibigay ng maraming sanga na dadaanan ng electric current, kaya bawat appliance ay may sariling daan.
fact.bis: Ang parallel circuit naghatag ug daghang sanga nga agianan sa electric current, busa ang matag appliance adunay kaugalingong agianan.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three separate wire branches, each branch holding one bulb, showing the current splitting into three paths.

fact.en:
Does the electric current get used up as it passes through each bulb in a series circuit?

No! The current is the same everywhere in a series circuit, because there is only one path for the charge to flow through.
fact.tl:
Nauubos ba ang electric current habang dumadaan ito sa bawat bulb sa series circuit?

Hindi! Pareho ang current sa lahat ng bahagi ng series circuit, dahil iisa lang ang daanan ng charge.
fact.bis:
Mahurot ba ang electric current samtang moagi kini sa matag bulb sa series circuit?

Dili! Pareho ang current sa tanang parte sa series circuit, tungod kay usa ra ang agianan sa charge.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs glowing equally bright, with an ammeter symbol at two different points showing the same reading.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, each branch receives the full voltage from the source, so every bulb gets the same push of energy.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, natatanggap ng bawat sanga ang buong voltage mula sa source, kaya pareho ang lakas ng energy na nakukuha ng bawat bulb.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang matag sanga makadawat sa tibuok voltage gikan sa source, busa pareho ang kusog sa energy nga makuha sa matag bulb.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three bulbs, each on its own branch, all glowing with the same brightness, with a voltmeter across one branch.

fact.en:
What happens if one bulb burns out in a series circuit?

All the other bulbs go out too! A break anywhere in a series circuit stops the current in the entire loop.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung mapundi ang isang bulb sa series circuit?

Mamamatay din ang lahat ng iba pang bulb! Ang pagkaputol kahit saan sa series circuit ay humihinto sa current sa buong loop.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung mapalong ang usa ka bulb sa series circuit?

Mangapalong usab ang tanang laing bulb! Ang pagkaputol bisan asa sa series circuit mopahunong sa current sa tibuok loop.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs where one bulb is dark and cracked, and the other two bulbs are also dark, showing no current flowing.

fact.en: If one branch of a parallel circuit breaks, the other branches keep working because each has its own separate path for current.
fact.tl: Kung maputol ang isang sanga ng parallel circuit, patuloy pa ring gagana ang ibang sanga dahil bawat isa ay may sariling daanan ng current.
fact.bis: Kung maputol ang usa ka sanga sa parallel circuit, magpadayon gihapon ang laing mga sanga tungod kay ang matag usa adunay kaugalingong agianan sa current.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three branches, where one branch has a broken wire and its bulb is dark, while the other two bulbs still glow brightly.

fact.en: Homes use parallel connections for appliances so that each one gets full voltage and can be turned on or off without affecting the others.
fact.tl: Gumagamit ang mga tahanan ng parallel connection para sa mga appliance upang makuha ng bawat isa ang buong voltage at kaya nilang buksan o patayin nang hindi naaapektuhan ang iba.
fact.bis: Ang mga panimalay naggamit ug parallel connection alang sa mga appliance aron ang matag usa makakuha sa tibuok voltage ug makabukas o makapalong nga dili maapektuhan ang uban.

cards.illustration: A simple house outline with several appliances like a TV, refrigerator, and lamp, each connected to the main power line by its own separate wire.

fact.en:
Why does the power suddenly go off when too many appliances are used at once?

A circuit breaker detects too much current and automatically switches off the circuit, protecting the wires from overheating.
fact.tl:
Bakit biglang namamatay ang kuryente kapag sabay-sabay na ginagamit ang maraming appliance?

Nadedetect ng circuit breaker ang sobrang current at kusa nitong pinapatay ang circuit, para hindi uminit nang sobra ang mga wire.
fact.bis:
Ngano nga kalit man mopalong ang kuryente kung daghan kaayong appliance ang gigamit nga dungan?

Ang circuit breaker makadetect sa sobra nga current ug awtomatiko kining mopalong sa circuit, aron dili mag-overheat ang mga wire.

cards.illustration: A wall electrical panel with one switch flipped to the off position, while a toaster and electric kettle are plugged into outlets nearby.
